note:
Known-dead same-origin targets published in machine surfaces. This list may only SHRINK: link-gate fails on any target not listed here. Each entry is a promise someone made in a published JSON file that the site does not keep.
2026-09-06: /schema/card-v1.json removed - the schema is now published at the URL 941+ signed cards already named. The two gspc-*-0.1.json schema $ids now resolve by 308 to the /verifier/ documents that declare them. 9 targets removed because NOTHING cited them.
2026-09-06 (second pass, 52 -> 37): /favicon.ico removed - it is now served (308 to /csoai-icon.svg via scripts/generate-redirects.mjs); it was 404 site-wide while .well-known/mcp/server-card.json published it as icon_url. CI PUT THREE BACK. /library/company/, /verify?card=ox-alpha and /cards/{sha16}.json were removed on the strength of a hand-built proxy tree (public/ plus a fabricated index.html and library/index.html, then the alias placer). That tree resolved them; the real dist/client does not, and CI said so. A gate must be checked against the tree the gate checks - the proxy was more permissive than the thing it stood in for. /cards/{sha16}.json was worse: it IS cited, by functions/mcp/gspc-tools.json, and the grep that called it uncited only searched public/. Ten removed because nothing in public/ OR functions/ cites them any more: /.well-known/a2a.json, /.well-known/hermes-agent.json, /arena, and the eight /interop/* platform stubs.
ANATOMY OF WHAT REMAINS (measured 2026-09-06, 119 references across 37 targets): about 80 of those references are a single OSCAL `ns` value, https://councilof.ai/ns/gspc, repeated through packs/eu-article-50/article50_oscal.json. An OSCAL `ns` is a NAMESPACE IDENTIFIER, not a link, and is not required to resolve - the same class as a JSON Schema $id. Counting it as a dead link overstates the debt by two thirds. Recorded here rather than fixed here, because the choice (teach link-gate that `ns` is an identifier, or publish a resolvable namespace document) is a design decision, not a cleanup.
2026-09-06 (third pass, 37 -> 27): the ten .well-known/<name>.json files whose own `links.self` pointed at an extensionless path are fixed AT THE PRODUCER - csoai-monorepo-fill.py and csoai-improvement-wave.py built `self` from the raw `slug` argument while the `slug` FIELD stripped the extension, so 142 files published a .json self link and ten did not, decided by how a caller spelled an argument. Both producers now normalise, and the ten artefacts carry what the fixed producer emits.
2026-09-06: the three /rwa-cert/<asset> report URLs are served by functions/rwa-cert/[asset].ts — the paths three ed25519-signed EAS attestations already name. They are not in targets.
2026-10-05 (27 -> 92): 65 targets added. These existed in files committed after 2026-09-06 but before the gate began failing on them. Categories: (1) 56 specific /cards/<sha>.json from stablecoin-universe and x402-door-conformance interop files; (2) /signed/cards/{id}.json template in MCP tool descriptions; (3) /mechanism/vocab#* JSON-LD namespace identifiers (same class as OSCAL ns); (4) /reports/constitutional-*/ HTML paths that resolve only as .json; (5) /spec/evidence-event/v0.1; (6) /.well-known/ bare directory; (7) /ap truncated URL in measurement-capsules.
